title: Madhya-khanda, part 21 (portion 44)
html:
The section "Meeting with Sarvabhauma" (beginning): Tamoluk, Gopala at Remuna, the Vaitarani, Varaha, Yajapura and Viraja; a toll-collector binds Mukunda, and the Lord appears in a dream to his chief; Ekamra (Bhubaneshvara) and the hymn to Shiva; the conversation of Murari and Damodara on the remnants of offerings to Shiva

Meeting with Sarvabhauma

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. Sriman Mahaprabhu, passing on the way through Tamoluk, bathing in the Brahma-kunda and seeing Sri Madhusudana, came within a few days to Remuna. There, having seen Sri Gopaladeva, installed by Uddhava, He spent that night absorbed in prema in dancing and singing. The next day, having bathed in the Vaitarani and seen Lord Varaha, He came to the village of Yajapura, saw many lingas of Shiva and joyfully beheld Viraja. There the Lord bathed in the Brahma-kunda, [made offerings to the forefathers at] Nabhi-gaya and from there came to a great holy place, the town of Shiva. [There] a toll-collector mistreated Mukunda, and Gaurahari appeared at night in a dream to the chief of the toll-collectors in the form of the One who lies on the Ocean of Milk and rebuked him for mistreating His devotee; he, frightened, surrendered at the Lord's feet. Then the Lord came from there to Ekamra-kanana, saw ten million lingas of Shiva, Mahesha and Parvati, recited many hymns of praise to Shiva and spent that night there. Next, in the conversation of Murari and Damodara, the question whether Shiva's prasada is worthy of a Vaishnava's respect is settled: it is established that the remnants of offerings to Shiva worshipped by non-devotees are not to be accepted. Then, [passing] Kapoteshvara, He came to the river Bhargavi, bathed there, and, going a little farther and seeing the pinnacle of the temple of Sri Jagannathadeva, fainted in prema; on regaining outer consciousness He bathed again and, offering praises and prayers, came to the house of Sarvabhauma. Sarvabhauma, seeing His form and mahabhava, surmised that He was Bhagavan and told his son to take Him to see Jagannatha. The Lord, standing behind the Garuda pillar, beheld Jagannatha and, absorbed in prema, danced and sang with the devotees; then He was brought from there back to Sarvabhauma's house. After this are described: Sarvabhauma's questions about the Lord, the taking of mahaprasada, the glorification of prasada, another darshana of Jagannatha, Sarvabhauma's [concern] for the Lord's [keeping of] sannyasa, the Lord's questions to Sarvabhauma, the showing of the six-armed form to Sarvabhauma, and so on.1

Raga bhatiyari; disha: "Brothers, sing, O sing the glory and the virtues of Gora Gosani! (murchha) O brothers, my dear brothers, harbour no worldly desires: as long as you live in the world, do not leave the feet of Mahaprabhu!"

তবে সেইমতে প্রভু চলি' যায় পথে ।
তমোলুকে উত্তরিলা মহাপুণ্যক্ষেত্রে ॥ ১ ॥

tabe seimate prabhu cali' yāẏa pathe |
tamoluke uttarilā mahāpuṇyakṣetre || 1 ||

tabe seimate — thus; prabhu chali yaya pathe — the Lord goes along the road; tamoluke uttarila — arrived at Tamoluk; maha-punya-kshetre — the great holy place

1Thus the Lord walked along the road
and came to Tamoluk, a great holy place.

ব্রহ্মকুণ্ডে স্নান, দেখি' শ্রীমধুসূদন ।
প্রেমায় অবশ প্রভু আনন্দিত মন ॥ ২ ॥

brahmakuṇḍe snāna, dekhi' śrīmadhusūdana |
premāẏa abaśa prabhu ānandita mana || 2 ||

brahma-kunde snana — bathing in the Brahma-kunda; dekhi shri-madhusudana — seeing Sri Madhusudana; premaya abasha prabhu — the Lord overcome with prema; anandita mana — His heart rejoicing

2Having bathed in the Brahma-kunda and seen Sri Madhusudana,
the Lord is overcome with prema, and His heart rejoices.2

এইমতে কথোদিন পথে চলি' যায় ।
উত্তরিলা মহাপ্রভু গ্রাম রেমুণায় ॥ ৩ ॥

eimate kathodina pathe cali' yāẏa |
uttarilā mahāprabhu grāma remuṇāẏa || 3 ||

eimate — thus; kathodina pathe chali yaya — walks some days on the road; uttarila mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu arrived; grama remunaya — at the village of Remuna

3Thus He walked for some days
and came, Mahaprabhu, to the village of Remuna.

মহাপুরী-রেমুণাতে আছয়ে গোপাল ।
দেখিবারে যায় প্রভু আনন্দ অপার ॥ ৪ ॥

mahāpurī-remuṇāte āchaẏe gopāla |
dekhibāre yāẏa prabhu ānanda apāra || 4 ||

mahapuri-remunate — in the great town of Remuna; achhaye gopala — dwells Gopala; dekhibare yaya prabhu — the Lord goes to see; ananda apara — with boundless joy

4In the great town of Remuna dwells Gopala;
the Lord goes to see Him with boundless joy.

পূর্বে বারাণসী-তীর্থে উদ্ধব-স্থাপিত ।
ব্রাহ্মণেরে কৃপা-ছলে এথা উপনীত ॥ ৫ ॥

pūrbe bārāṇasī-tīrthe uddhaba-sthāpita |
brāhmaṇere kṛpā-chale ethā upanīta || 5 ||

purve varanasi-tirthe — formerly in holy Varanasi; uddhava-sthapita — installed by Uddhava; brahmanere kripa-chhale — out of mercy to a brahmana; etha upanita — came here

5Formerly He was installed by Uddhava in holy Varanasi,
and He came here to show mercy to a brahmana.3

ইহা বলি' পুনঃ পুনঃ করে নমস্কার ।
'উদ্ধবের প্রভু' বলি' করে হুহুঙ্কার ॥ ৬ ॥

ihā bali' punaḥ punaḥ kare namaskāra |
'uddhabera prabhu' bali' kare huhuṅkāra || 6 ||

iha bali — saying this; punah punah kare namaskara — bows again and again; uddhavera prabhu bali — crying "Lord of Uddhava!"; kare huhunkara — roars

6Saying this, [the Lord] bows again and again
and, crying "Lord of Uddhava!", roars aloud.

নয়ন সফল আজি দেখিল ঠাকুর ।
উদ্ধব-সম্বন্ধে প্রেমা বাড়িল প্রচুর ॥ ৭ ॥

naẏana saphala āji dekhila ṭhākura |
uddhaba-sambandhe premā bāṛila pracura || 7 ||

nayana saphala aji — today the eyes bore fruit; dekhila thakura — I saw the Lord; uddhava-sambandhe — through the connection with Uddhava; prema badila prachura — prema grew abundantly

7"Today My eyes have borne fruit: I have seen the Lord!"
Through the connection with Uddhava His prema grew immensely.

উদ্ধব উদ্ধব বলি' ডাকে আর্তনাদে ।
প্রেমায় বিহ্বল ক্ষণে ভূমে পড়ি' কান্দে ॥ ৮ ॥

uddhaba uddhaba bali' ḍāke ārtanāde |
premāẏa bihbala kṣaṇe bhūme paṛi' kānde || 8 ||

uddhava uddhava bali — saying "Uddhava! Uddhava!"; dake artanade — calls with a cry of anguish; premaya vihvala — overwhelmed with prema; kshane bhume padi kande — now falls to the ground and weeps

8With a cry of anguish He calls, "Uddhava! Uddhava!"
and, overwhelmed with prema, falls again and again to the ground and weeps.

অরুণ-নয়নে নীর ঝরে অনিবার ।
পুলকে পূরিল অঙ্গ কম্প বারে বার ॥ ৯ ॥

aruṇa-naẏane nīra jhare anibāra |
pulake pūrila aṅga kampa bāre bāra || 9 ||

aruna-nayane — from reddish eyes; nira jhare anibara — tears flow without cease; pulake purila anga — the body filled with thrill; kampa bare bara — trembling again and again

9From His reddish eyes tears flow without cease,
His body thrills, and trembling seizes Him again and again.

'উদ্ধবের প্রভু' বলি' প্রদক্ষিণ করি' ।
নিজজন-সঙ্গে নাচে বোলে হরি হরি ॥ ১০ ॥

'uddhabera prabhu' bali' pradakṣiṇa kari' |
nijajana-saṅge nāce bole hari hari || 10 ||

uddhavera prabhu bali — crying "Lord of Uddhava!"; pradakshina kari — circumambulating; nijajana-sange nache — dances with His own people; bole hari hari — says "Hari! Hari!"

10Crying "Lord of Uddhava!", He walks around [the Deity]
and dances with His own people, chanting "Hari! Hari!"

উথলিল প্রেমানন্দ — বাড়িল উল্লাস ।
প্রেমায় ছাইল জন এ ভূমি-আকাশ ॥ ১১ ॥

uthalila premānanda — bāṛila ullāsa |
premāẏa chāila jana e bhūmi-ākāśa || 11 ||

uthalila premananda — the bliss of prema surged; badila ullasa — jubilation grew; premaya chhaila — prema covered; jana e bhumi-akasha — the people, this earth and sky

11The bliss of prema surged, the jubilation grew;
prema flooded the people, this earth and the sky.

আনন্দে দেবতা সব চাহে অন্তরীক্ষে ।
অনিমিখ-আঁখি তারা প্রভুকে নিরীখে ॥ ১২ ॥

ānande debatā saba cāhe antarīkṣe |
animikha-āṁkhi tārā prabhuke nirīkhe || 12 ||

anande devata saba — in joy all the gods; chahe antarikshe — look from the sky; animikha-ankhi tara — with unblinking eyes they; prabhuke nirikhe — gaze at the Lord

12In joy all the gods look on from the heavens,
with unblinking eyes they gaze at the Lord.

সহস্র-নয়ানে ইন্দ্র চাহে একদিঠে ।
অমৃত-অধিক গৌরাঙ্গ লাগে মিঠে ॥ ১৩ ॥

sahasra-naẏāne indra cāhe ekadiṭhe |
amṛta-adhika gaurāṅga lāge miṭhe || 13 ||

sahasra-nayane — with a thousand eyes; indra chahe eka-dithe — Indra gazes intently; amrita-adhika — more than nectar; gauranga lage mithe — Gauranga seems sweet

13Indra with his thousand eyes gazes intently:
Gauranga seems to him sweeter than nectar.

হেনই সময়ে সেই মুরতি-গোপাল ।
মস্তক-উপরে পুষ্প-মুকুট তাহার ॥ ১৪ ॥

henai samaẏe sei murati-gopāla |
mastaka-upare puṣpa-mukuṭa tāhāra || 14 ||

henai samaye — just then; sei murati-gopala — that Deity Gopala; mastaka-upare — upon the head; pushpa-mukuta tahara — His crown of flowers

14At that very time, on the head
of the Deity Gopala there was a crown of flowers.

আচম্বিতে মস্তকের মুকুট খসিতে ।
ভূমিতে পড়িবামাত্র তুলি' লৈল হাতে ॥ ১৫ ॥

ācambite mastakera mukuṭa khasite |
bhūmite paṛibāmātra tuli' laila hāte || 15 ||

achambite — suddenly; mastakera mukuta khasite — as the crown slipped from the head; bhumite padibamatra — the moment it fell to the ground; tuli laila hate — [the Lord] picked it up in His hand

15Suddenly the crown slipped from His head,
and, the moment it fell to the ground, [the Lord] picked it up in His hand.4

চৌদিগে বৈষ্ণবগণ হরি হরি বোলে ।
আকাশ পরশে হেন প্রেমার হিল্লোলে ॥ ১৬ ॥

caudige baiṣṇabagaṇa hari hari bole |
ākāśa paraśe hena premāra hillole || 16 ||

chaudige vaishnava-gana — all around the Vaishnavas; hari hari bole — cry "Hari! Hari!"; akasha parashe hena — as if touching the sky; premara hillole — the waves of prema

16All around, the Vaishnavas cry "Hari! Hari!";
the waves of prema seem to touch the sky.

দেখিলেন দেবরাজ প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
অদ্ভুত দেখিয়া কান্দে প্রণতকন্ধর ॥ ১৭ ॥

dekhilena debarāja prabhu biśbambhara |
adbhuta dekhiẏā kānde praṇatakandhara || 17 ||

dekhilena devaraja — the king of the gods beheld; prabhu vishvambhara — Lord Vishvambhara; adbhuta dekhiya — seeing the wonder; kande pranatakandhara — weeps with bowed head

17The king of the gods beheld Lord Vishvambhara
and, seeing this wonder, weeps with his head bowed.

দিনান্তে নাচয়ে প্রভু নাহিক বিরাম ।
সন্ধ্যার সময়ে হৈল নৃত্য-অবসান ॥ ১৮ ॥

dinānte nācaẏe prabhu nāhika birāma |
sandhyāra samaẏe haila nṛtya-abasāna || 18 ||

dinante nachaye prabhu — till day's end the Lord dances; nahika virama — without rest; sandhyara samaye — at evening; haila nritya-avasana — the dancing ended

18Till the end of the day the Lord dances without rest;
only at evening did the dancing cease.

নানা উপহার-দ্রব্য কৃষ্ণে নিবেদিত ।
প্রভুর সম্মুখে বিপ্র কৈল উপনীত ॥ ১৯ ॥

nānā upahāra-drabya kṛṣṇe nibedita |
prabhura sammukhe bipra kaila upanīta || 19 ||

nana upahara-dravya — many dishes; krishne nivedita — offered to Krishna; prabhura sammukhe — before the Lord; vipra kaila upanita — a brahmana brought

19Many dishes offered to Krishna
a brahmana brought and set before the Lord.

আনন্দিত মহাপ্রভু লঞা নিজজন ।
সন্তোষে করিল মহাপ্রসাদ-ভোজন ॥ ২০ ॥

ānandita mahāprabhu lañā nijajana |
santoṣe karila mahāprasāda-bhojana || 20 ||

anandita mahaprabhu — joyful Mahaprabhu; lanya nijajana — with His own people; santoshe karila — happily did; mahaprasada-bhojana — the eating of mahaprasada

20Joyful, Mahaprabhu with His own people
happily partook of the mahaprasada.

রজনী গোঙায় কৃষ্ণকথার আনন্দে ।
প্রভাতে চলিলা নিজজন লঞা সঙ্গে ॥ ২১ ॥

rajanī goṅāẏa kṛṣṇakathāra ānande |
prabhāte calilā nijajana lañā saṅge || 21 ||

rajani gongaya — He spends the night; krishna-kathara anande — in the bliss of talks of Krishna; prabhate chalila — in the morning set out; nijajana lanya sange — taking His own people along

21He spent the night in the bliss of talks about Krishna
and in the morning set out with His own people.

এইমত প্রভু পথে যাইতে যাইতে ।
নদী-বৈতরণী-তটে গেলা আচম্বিতে ॥ ২২ ॥

eimata prabhu pathe yāite yāite |
nadī-baitaraṇī-taṭe gelā ācambite || 22 ||

eimata prabhu — thus the Lord; pathe yaite yaite — going along the road; nadi-vaitarani-tate — to the bank of the river Vaitarani; gela achambite — came unexpectedly

22Thus the Lord went along the road
and unexpectedly came to the bank of the river Vaitarani.

স্নান-পানে সেই নদী পতিতপাবনী ।
আর তাহে স্নান কৈল ঠাকুর আপনি ॥ ২৩ ॥

snāna-pāne sei nadī patitapābanī |
āra tāhe snāna kaila ṭhākura āpani || 23 ||

snana-pane — by bathing and drinking; sei nadi patita-pavani — that river purifies the fallen; ara tahe snana kaila — and in it bathed; thakura apani — the Thakura Himself

23Bathing in and drinking [the water of] this river purify the fallen —
and in it the Thakura Himself bathed.

তবে চলি' যায় সেই পরম চতুর ।
দেখিবারে বাড়ে সাধ বরাহ-ঠাকুর ॥ ২৪ ॥

tabe cali' yāẏa sei parama catura |
dekhibāre bāṛe sādha barāha-ṭhākura || 24 ||

tabe chali yaya — then goes on; sei parama chatura — He, the wisest; dekhibare bade sadha — the wish grows to see; baraha-thakura — Lord Varaha

24Then He, the wisest, goes on:
His wish grows to see Lord Varaha,

যাহা দেখি' সর্বলোক উদ্ধারে দু-কুল ।
তবে চলি' যায় প্রভু গ্রাম যাজপুর ॥ ২৫ ॥

yāhā dekhi' sarbaloka uddhāre du-kula |
tabe cali' yāẏa prabhu grāma yājapura || 25 ||

yaha dekhi — seeing whom; sarva-loka uddhare du-kula — all people deliver both sides of their family; tabe chali yaya prabhu — then the Lord goes; grama yajapura — to the village of Yajapura

25seeing whom all people deliver their families on both sides.
Then the Lord goes to the village of Yajapura,

যাহা যজ্ঞ কৈলা ব্রহ্মা লঞা দেবগণ ।
ব্রাহ্মণেরে দিল গ্রাম করিয়া শাসন ॥ ২৬ ॥

yāhā yajña kailā brahmā lañā debagaṇa |
brāhmaṇere dila grāma kariẏā śāsana || 26 ||

yaha yajna kaila brahma — where Brahma performed sacrifice; lanya deva-gana — with the gods; brahmanere dila grama — gave the village to the brahmanas; kariya shasana — by charter

26where Brahma with all the gods performed a sacrifice
and gave the village to the brahmanas by charter.

মহাপাপী নর যদি সেই গ্রামে মরে ।
সর্বপাপে মুক্ত হৈয়া শিবরূপ ধরে ॥ ২৭ ॥

mahāpāpī nara yadi sei grāme mare |
sarbapāpe mukta haiẏā śibarūpa dhare || 27 ||

mahapapi nara — a great sinner; yadi sei grame mare — if he dies in that village; sarva-pape mukta haiya — freed from all sins; shiva-rupa dhare — takes on the form of Shiva

27Even a great sinner, if he dies in this village,
is freed from all sins and attains the form of Shiva.5

শত শত আছে তাহে মহেশের লিঙ্গ ।
তাহা নমস্করি' যায় গৌরগোবিন্দ ॥ ২৮ ॥

śata śata āche tāhe maheśera liṅga |
tāhā namaskari' yāẏa gauragobinda || 28 ||

shata shata achhe tahe — there are hundreds there; maheshera linga — of lingas of Mahesha; taha namaskari — bowing to them; yaya gaura-govinda — Gaura-Govinda goes

28There are hundreds of lingas of Mahesha there;
Gaura-Govinda goes on, bowing to them.

আনন্দ-হৃদয়ে যায় বিরজা দেখিতে ।
বিরজা-মহিমা কে বা পারয়ে কহিতে ॥ ২৯ ॥

ānanda-hṛdaẏe yāẏa birajā dekhite |
birajā-mahimā ke bā pāraẏe kahite || 29 ||

ananda-hridaye yaya — with joy in His heart He goes; viraja dekhite — to see Viraja; viraja-mahima — the glory of Viraja; ke va paraye kahite — who can describe

29With joy in His heart He goes to see Viraja;
who can describe the glory of Viraja?

কোটি কোটি পাতক নাশয়ে দরশনে ।
বিরজা দেখিল প্রভু হরষিত-মনে ॥ ৩০ ॥

koṭi koṭi pātaka nāśaẏe daraśane |
birajā dekhila prabhu haraṣita-mane || 30 ||

koti koti pataka — millions of sins; nashaye darashane — her sight destroys; viraja dekhila prabhu — the Lord saw Viraja; harashita-mane — with a joyful heart

30The sight of her destroys millions of sins;
with a joyful heart the Lord beheld Viraja.

বিরজাকে নমস্করি' কহিল বচন ।
দেহ প্রেমভক্তি মোরে কৃষ্ণের চরণ ॥ ৩১ ॥

birajāke namaskari' kahila bacana |
deha premabhakti more kṛṣṇera caraṇa || 31 ||

virajake namaskari — bowing to Viraja; kahila vachana — He spoke; deha prema-bhakti more — give Me prema-bhakti; krishnera charana — [for] Krishna's feet

31Bowing to Viraja, He said:
"Give Me prema-bhakti for the feet of Krishna."6

এইমত মহাপ্রভু পথে চলি' যায় ।
পিতৃপিণ্ডদান কৈল এ নাভিগয়ায় ॥ ৩২ ॥

eimata mahāprabhu pathe cali' yāẏa |
pitṛpiṇḍadāna kaila e nābhigaẏāẏa || 32 ||

eimata mahaprabhu — thus Mahaprabhu; pathe chali yaya — goes along the road; pitri-pinda-dana kaila — offered pinda to the forefathers; e nabhigayaya — here at Nabhi-gaya

32Thus Mahaprabhu went along the road
and here, at Nabhi-gaya, offered pinda to the forefathers.

ব্রহ্মকুণ্ড-জলে স্নান কৈল হরষিতে ।
দেবকার্য সমাপিয়া চলিলা ত্বরিতে ॥ ৩৩ ॥

brahmakuṇḍa-jale snāna kaila haraṣite |
debakārya samāpiẏā calilā tbarite || 33 ||

brahma-kunda-jale — in the waters of the Brahma-kunda; snana kaila harashite — bathed joyfully; deva-karya samapiya — finishing the rites; chalila tvarite — went on quickly

33He bathed joyfully in the waters of the Brahma-kunda
and, having finished the rites, went on quickly.

মহাপুণ্যস্থান সেই শিবের নগর ।
দেখিতে দেখিতে প্রভু ভৈগেল বিভোর ॥ ৩৪ ॥

mahāpuṇyasthāna sei śibera nagara |
dekhite dekhite prabhu bhaigela bibhora || 34 ||

maha-punya-sthana — great holy place; sei shivera nagara — that town of Shiva; dekhite dekhite — gazing; prabhu bhaigela vibhora — the Lord was rapt

34That great holy place is the town of Shiva;
gazing at it, the Lord was rapt.

কহিতে না পারি সে নগর-পরিপাটী ।
ত্রিলোচন-আদি করি' আছে লিঙ্গ-কোটি ॥ ৩৫ ॥

kahite nā pāri se nagara-paripāṭī |
trilocana-ādi kari' āche liṅga-koṭi || 35 ||

kahite na pari — I cannot describe; se nagara-paripati — the splendour of that town; trilochana-adi kari — headed by Trilochana; achhe linga-koti — there are millions of lingas

35I cannot describe the splendour of that town:
there are millions of lingas, headed by Trilochana.7

হেনই সময়ে সেই শ্রীমুকুন্দ দত্ত ।
প্রভুর সাক্ষাতে কহে যে জানয়ে তত্ত্ব ॥ ৩৬ ॥

henai samaẏe sei śrīmukunda datta |
prabhura sākṣāte kahe ye jānaẏe tattba || 36 ||

henai samaye — at that time; sei shri-mukunda datta — that Sri Mukunda Datta; prabhura sakshate kahe — says before the Lord; ye janaye tattva — who knew the facts

36At that very time Sri Mukunda Datta,
who knew [the local] ways, says to the Lord:

এই হৈতে দানীকে নাহিক আর ভয় ।
আমি সর্ব জানি দুষ্ট যে যেখানে রয় ॥ ৩৭ ॥

ei haite dānīke nāhika āra bhaẏa |
āmi sarba jāni duṣṭa ye yekhāne raẏa || 37 ||

ei haite — from here; danike nahika ara bhaya — there is no more fear of toll-collectors; ami sarva jani — I know all; dushta ye yekhane raya — where each rogue lives

37"From here on there is nothing more to fear from toll-collectors:
I know them all, I know where each rogue lives."

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু মুচকি হাসয়ে ।
কি বলিব তোরে মুঞি তুমি মহাশয়ে ॥ ৩৮ ॥

e bola śuniñā prabhu mucaki hāsaẏe |
ki baliba tore muñi tumi mahāśaẏe || 38 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu muchaki hasaye — the Lord smiles faintly; ki baliba tore munni — what shall I say to you; tumi mahashaye — you are a man of consequence

38Hearing this, the Lord smiled faintly:
"What shall I say to you? You are a man of consequence!

আমি ত সন্ন্যাস-ধর্ম করিয়াছি আশ্রয় ।
দানী কি করিব মোর কহ ত নিশ্চয় ॥ ৩৯ ॥

āmi ta sannyāsa-dharma kariẏāchi āśraẏa |
dānī ki kariba mora kaha ta niścaẏa || 39 ||

ami ta sannyasa-dharma — I have the dharma of sannyasa; kariyachhi ashraya — taken up; dani ki kariba mora — what will a toll-collector do to Me; kaha ta nishchaya — tell for certain

39I have taken up the dharma of sannyasa —
what can a toll-collector do to Me? Tell Me truly."

শুনিঞা মুকুন্দ কিছু ভয় না পাইল ।
তবু দুঃখ দেয় প্রভু তোমারে কহিল ॥ ৪০ ॥

śuniñā mukunda kichu bhaẏa nā pāila |
tabu duḥkha deẏa prabhu tomāre kahila || 40 ||

shuninya mukunda — hearing, Mukunda; kichhu bhaya na paila — felt no fear at all; tabu duhkha deya — still they cause trouble; prabhu tomare kahila — Lord, I have told You

40Hearing this, Mukunda was not in the least afraid:
"Still, they cause trouble, Lord — I have told You."

শুনিঞা ঠাকুর বোলে — শুনহ মুকুন্দ ।
রাখিবে আমার দেহ সকল কুটুম্ব ॥ ৪১ ॥

śuniñā ṭhākura bole — śunaha mukunda |
rākhibe āmāra deha sakala kuṭumba || 41 ||

shuninya thakura bole — hearing, the Thakura says; shunaha mukunda — listen, Mukunda; rakhibe amara deha — will guard My body; sakala kutumba — all [My] kinsfolk

41Hearing this, the Thakura says, "Listen, Mukunda:
My body will be guarded by all My kinsfolk."

Thus in the Shanti-shataka:

ধৈর্যং যস্য পিতা ক্ষমা চ জননী শান্তিশ্চিরং গেহিনী
সত্যং সূনুরয়ং দয়া চ ভগিনী ভ্রাতা মনঃসংযমঃ ।
শয্যা ভূমিতলং দিশোঽপি বসনং জ্ঞানামৃতং ভোজনং
যস্যৈতে হি কুটুম্বিনো বদ সখে কস্মাদ্ভয়ং যোগিনঃ ॥ ৪২ ॥

dhairyaṃ yasya pitā kṣamā ca jananī śāntiściraṃ gehinī
satyaṃ sūnuraẏaṃ daẏā ca bhaginī bhrātā manaḥsaṃyamaḥ |
śayyā bhūmitalaṃ diśo'pi basanaṃ jñānāmṛtaṃ bhojanaṃ
yasyaite hi kuṭumbino bada sakhe kasmādbhaẏaṃ yoginaḥ || 42 ||

dhairyam yasya pita — whose father is fortitude; kshama cha janani — whose mother is forbearance; shantih chiram gehini — whose wife is lasting peace; satyam sunuh ayam — whose son is truth; daya cha bhagini — whose sister is compassion; bhrata manah-samyamah — whose brother is control of mind; shayya bhumi-talam — bed the ground; dishah api vasanam — garment the quarters; jnana-amritam bhojanam — food the nectar of knowledge; yasya ete hi kutumbinah — whose kinsfolk are these; vada sakhe — tell, friend; kasmat bhayam yoginah — whence fear for a yogi

42"He whose father is fortitude, whose mother is forbearance, whose wife is lasting peace,
whose son is truth, whose sister is compassion, whose brother is control of the mind,
whose bed is the ground, whose garment the quarters, whose food the nectar of knowledge —
with such kinsfolk, tell me, friend, what has a yogi to fear?"8

শুনিঞা মুকুন্দ ভয় না পাইল চিতে ।
কহিল তাহারে প্রভু হাসিতে হাসিতে ॥ ৪৩ ॥

śuniñā mukunda bhaẏa nā pāila cite |
kahila tāhāre prabhu hāsite hāsite || 43 ||

shuninya mukunda — hearing, Mukunda; bhaya na paila chite — felt no fear at heart; kahila tahare prabhu — the Lord said to him; hasite hasite — laughing

43Hearing this, Mukunda felt no fear in his heart.
The Lord, laughing, said to him:

এতদূর প্রতিপালি' আনিলে আমারে ।
ইহা বলি' চলি' গেলা ভিক্ষা করিবারে ॥ ৪৪ ॥

etadūra pratipāli' ānile āmāre |
ihā bali' cali' gelā bhikṣā karibāre || 44 ||

etadura pratipali — protecting [Me] this far; anile amare — you have brought Me; iha bali — saying this; chali gela bhiksha karibare — He went to beg alms

44"You have looked after Me and brought Me this far!"
and with these words He went to beg alms.

গদাধর-আদি করি' যত সঙ্গিগণ ।
ঠাঞি ঠাঞি গেলা সভে করিবারে ভিক্ষাটন ॥ ৪৫ ॥

gadādhara-ādi kari' yata saṅgigaṇa |
ṭhāñi ṭhāñi gelā sabhe karibāre bhikṣāṭana || 45 ||

gadadhara-adi kari — Gadadhara and the rest; yata sangi-gana — all the companions; thani thani gela sabhe — all went to various places; karibare bhikshatana — to go begging

45Gadadhara and all the companions
went off to various places to beg alms.

হেনকালে এক দানী রাখে তা-সভারে ।
মহাক্রোধ করি' দানী বান্ধে মুকুন্দেরে ॥ ৪৬ ॥

henakāle eka dānī rākhe tā-sabhāre |
mahākrodha kari' dānī bāndhe mukundere || 46 ||

henakale — then; eka dani rakhe ta-sabhare — a toll-collector held them all; maha-krodha kari — in great anger; dani bandhe mukundere — the toll-collector binds Mukunda

46Then a certain toll-collector held them all up
and in great anger bound Mukunda.

সারাদিন রাখিয়াছে — ক্রোধ নাহি পড়ে ।
অনেক যতনে প্রবোধিল সন্ধ্যাকালে ॥ ৪৭ ॥

sārādina rākhiẏāche — krodha nāhi paṛe |
aneka yatane prabodhila sandhyākāle || 47 ||

saradina rakhiyachhe — kept [him] all day; krodha nahi pade — the anger does not abate; aneka yatane — with great effort; prabodhila sandhyakale — [he] was talked round in the evening

47All day he kept him — his anger did not cool;
only in the evening, with great effort, was he talked round.

তা-সভার আছিল কম্বল একখণ্ড ।
কাড়িয়া লইল সেই পাপিষ্ঠ পাষণ্ড ॥ ৪৮ ॥

tā-sabhāra āchila kambala ekakhaṇḍa |
kāṛiẏā laila sei pāpiṣṭha pāṣaṇḍa || 48 ||

ta-sabhara achhila — they had; kambala ekakhanda — a single blanket; kadiya laila — snatched away; sei papishtha pashanda — that sinful villain

48They had just one blanket among them —
and that sinful villain snatched it away.

সন্ধ্যাকালে সভে ভিক্ষা করি' স্থানে স্থানে ।
সঙ্কেত-মণ্ডপে সভে আইলা জনে জনে ॥ ৪৯ ॥

sandhyākāle sabhe bhikṣā kari' sthāne sthāne |
saṅketa-maṇḍape sabhe āilā jane jane || 49 ||

sandhyakale — in the evening; sabhe bhiksha kari sthane sthane — all, having begged in various places; sanketa-mandape — to the agreed pavilion; sabhe aila jane jane — all came one by one

49In the evening, having begged alms in various places,
they all came one by one to the agreed pavilion.

সেই ত মণ্ডপে আগে আছেন ঠাকুর ।
দেখি' সর্বজন-হিয়া আনন্দ প্রচুর ॥ ৫০ ॥

sei ta maṇḍape āge āchena ṭhākura |
dekhi' sarbajana-hiẏā ānanda pracura || 50 ||

sei ta mandape — in that pavilion; age achhena thakura — the Thakura was already; dekhi — seeing [Him]; sarvajana-hiya ananda prachura — great joy in everyone's heart

50The Thakura was already in that pavilion;
seeing Him, all rejoiced greatly.

চরণে পড়িয়া কান্দে শ্রীমুকুন্দ দত্ত ।
আজিহো না জানি প্রভু তোমার মহত্ত্ব ॥ ৫১ ॥

caraṇe paṛiẏā kānde śrīmukunda datta |
ājiho nā jāni prabhu tomāra mahattba || 51 ||

charane padiya kande — fallen at His feet, weeps; shri-mukunda datta — Sri Mukunda Datta; ajiho na jani — till today I did not know; prabhu tomara mahattva — Lord, Your greatness

51Sri Mukunda Datta, fallen at His feet, weeps:
"Till today I did not know Your greatness, Lord!

তোমার সম্মুখে বৈল নাহি দানী-ভয় ।
তাহার লাগিয়া মোর এত দুঃখ হয় ॥ ৫২ ॥

tomāra sammukhe baila nāhi dānī-bhaẏa |
tāhāra lāgiẏā mora eta duḥkha haẏa || 52 ||

tomara sammukhe baila — before You I said; nahi dani-bhaya — there is no fear of toll-collectors; tahara lagiya — because of that; mora eta duhkha haya — I suffer so much

52Before You I said there was nothing to fear from toll-collectors —
and for that I have suffered so.

জানিয়া না জানে মূঢ় তুমি ভগবান্ ।
তোমার উপরে আর কে সাধিব দান ॥ ৫৩ ॥

jāniẏā nā jāne mūṛha tumi bhagabān |
tomāra upare āra ke sādhiba dāna || 53 ||

janiya na jane mudha — the fool knew yet did not know; tumi bhagavan — that You are Bhagavan; tomara upare — from You; ara ke sadhiba dana — who would take toll

53I knew, yet did not know, fool that I am, that You are Bhagavan:
who would take toll from You?

তোমার নাহিক ভয় এ তিন ভুবনে ।
তুমি সর্বেশ্বরেশ্বর কেবা তোমা জানে ॥ ৫৩+১ ॥

tomāra nāhika bhaẏa e tina bhubane |
tumi sarbeśbareśbara kebā tomā jāne || 53+1 ||

tomara nahika bhaya — You have no fear; e tina bhuvane — in the three worlds; tumi sarveshvareshvara — You are the Lord of the lords of all; keba toma jane — who knows You

53+1You have no fear in the three worlds:
You are the Lord of the lords of all — who knows You?9

তোমারে নির্ভয় করিবারে কহি কথা ।
ভাল হৈল দানী মোর করিল অবস্থা ॥ ৫৪ ॥

tomāre nirbhaẏa karibāre kahi kathā |
bhāla haila dānī mora karila abasthā || 54 ||

tomare nirbhaya karibare — to make You fearless; kahi katha — I spoke; bhala haila — it served me right; dani mora karila avastha — that the toll-collector put me in this state

54I said it so that You would be without fear —
and it served me right that the toll-collector did this to me."

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু গদাধরে পুছে ।
প্রত্যক্ষ কহিল দানী যত করিয়াছে ॥ ৫৫ ॥

e bola śuniñā prabhu gadādhare puche |
pratyakṣa kahila dānī yata kariẏāche || 55 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu gadadhare puchhe — the Lord asks Gadadhara; pratyaksha kahila — [he] told plainly; dani yata kariyachhe — all the toll-collector had done

55Hearing this, the Lord asks Gadadhara,
and he told plainly all that the toll-collector had done.

শুনিঞা ঠাকুর বৈল — নহ উতরোল ।
'ভাল হৈব' বলি' মাত্র বৈল এক বোল ॥ ৫৬ ॥

śuniñā ṭhākura baila — naha utarola |
'bhāla haiba' bali' mātra baila eka bola || 56 ||

shuninya thakura baila — hearing, the Thakura said; naha utarola — do not be upset; bhala haiba bali — "it will be well"; matra baila eka bola — He spoke just one word

56Hearing it, the Thakura said, "Do not be upset,"
and spoke just one word: "It will be well."

সেই রাত্রে সেই দেশে দানীর ঈশ্বর ।
স্বপ্নে দেখা দিল তারে শচীর কোঙর ॥ ৫৭ ॥

sei rātre sei deśe dānīra īśbara |
sbapne dekhā dila tāre śacīra koṅara || 57 ||

sei ratre — that night; sei deshe danira ishvara — to the chief of the toll-collectors in that land; svapne dekha dila tare — appeared to him in a dream; shachira kongara — the son of Shachi

57That very night, to the chief of the toll-collectors of that region
the son of Shachi appeared in a dream.

ক্ষীরোদ-সমুদ্রে দেখে অনন্তশয়নে ।
লক্ষ্মী-সরস্বতী করে চরণ-সেবনে ॥ ৫৮ ॥

kṣīroda-samudre dekhe anantaśaẏane |
lakṣmī-sarasbatī kare caraṇa-sebane || 58 ||

kshiroda-samudre dekhe — he sees on the Ocean of Milk; ananta-shayane — lying on Ananta; lakshmi-sarasvati kare — Lakshmi and Sarasvati do; charana-sevane — service to the feet

58He sees [Him] on the Ocean of Milk, lying on Ananta;
Lakshmi and Sarasvati serve His feet;

তাহার অন্তরে দেখে সনকাদি-গণ ।
ব্রহ্মা-আদি দেব দূরে করয়ে স্তবন ॥ ৫৯ ॥

tāhāra antare dekhe sanakādi-gaṇa |
brahmā-ādi deba dūre karaẏe stabana || 59 ||

tahara antare dekhe — within he sees; sanakadi-gana — Sanaka and the others; brahma-adi deva — Brahma and the other gods; dure karaye stavana — offer praises from afar

59within he sees Sanaka and the others,
and Brahma and the other gods offer praises from afar.

দেখিয়া দানীর রাজা কাঁপিল অন্তরে ।
ঐশ্বর্য দেখিয়া তিঁহো পড়িলা ফাঁপরে ॥ ৬০ ॥

dekhiẏā dānīra rājā kāṁpila antare |
aiśbarya dekhiẏā tiṁho paṛilā phāṁpare || 60 ||

dekhiya danira raja — seeing, the king of the toll-collectors; kampila antare — trembled at heart; aishvarya dekhiya — seeing the majesty; tinho padila phanpare — he was dismayed

60Seeing this, the king of the toll-collectors trembled in his heart:
seeing [such] majesty, he was dismayed.

বিরজা-নিকটে আছি সন্ন্যাসীর বেশে ।
মোর ভক্তে দুঃখ দিল তোর সব দাসে ॥ ৬১ ॥

birajā-nikaṭe āchi sannyāsīra beśe |
mora bhakte duḥkha dila tora saba dāse || 61 ||

viraja-nikate achhi — I am near Viraja; sannyasira veshe — in the guise of a sannyasi; mora bhakte duhkha dila — have wronged My devotee; tora saba dase — all your servants

61"I am near Viraja in the guise of a sannyasi;
all your servants have wronged My devotee."

কাঁপিল অন্তরে — ত্রাস পাইল অপার ।
সত্বরে চলিলা যথা শ্রীগৌরগোপাল ॥ ৬২ ॥

kāṁpila antare — trāsa pāila apāra |
satbare calilā yathā śrīgauragopāla || 62 ||

kampila antare — trembled at heart; trasa paila apara — was boundlessly afraid; satvare chalila — hurried; yatha shri-gaura-gopala — to where Sri Gaura-Gopala was

62He trembled in his heart, was seized with boundless fear,
and hurried to where Sri Gaura-Gopala was.

কথোক্ষণে সেইখানে সেই দানীশ্বর ।
প্রভু নমস্করি' করে বিনয় বিস্তর ॥ ৬৩ ॥

kathokṣaṇe seikhāne sei dānīśbara |
prabhu namaskari' kare binaẏa bistara || 63 ||

kathokshane — after a while; seikhane — there; sei danishvara — that chief of the toll-collectors; prabhu namaskari — bowing to the Lord; kare vinaya vistara — speaks with great humility

63Arriving there shortly, that chief of the toll-collectors
bowed to the Lord and speaks with great humility:

তুমি ভগবান্ ক্ষীরনিধির বিলাস ।
জীব নিস্তারিতে প্রভু করিয়াছ সন্ন্যাস ॥ ৬৪ ॥

tumi bhagabān kṣīranidhira bilāsa |
jība nistārite prabhu kariẏācha sannyāsa || 64 ||

tumi bhagavan — You are Bhagavan; kshiranidhira vilasa — who sports in the Ocean of Milk; jiva nistarite — to deliver the jivas; prabhu kariyachha sannyasa — Lord, You have taken sannyasa

64"You are Bhagavan, who sports in the Ocean of Milk;
to deliver the jivas You have taken sannyasa, Lord.

তুমি ভব-ঘোর-অন্ধকারের চন্দ্রিমা ।
তুমি বেদ — বেদের পরমতত্ত্ব-সীমা ॥ ৬৫ ॥

tumi bhaba-ghora-andhakārera candrimā |
tumi beda — bedera paramatattba-sīmā || 65 ||

tumi bhava-ghora-andhakarera chandrima — You are the moon of the dreadful darkness of worldly existence; tumi veda — You are the Veda; vedera parama-tattva-sima — the utmost bound of the Vedas' highest truth

65You are the moon for the dreadful darkness of worldly existence;
You are the Veda and the utmost bound of the Vedas' highest truth."

শুনি' গোরাচাঁদ হাসি' বলিলা তাহারে ।
অচিরাতে কৃষ্ণ কৃপা করুন তোমারে ॥ ৬৬ ॥

śuni' gorācāṁda hāsi' balilā tāhāre |
acirāte kṛṣṇa kṛpā karuna tomāre || 66 ||

shuni gorachanda — hearing, Gorachand; hasi balila tahare — said to him with a smile; achirate krishna — soon may Krishna; kripa karuna tomare — show you mercy

66Hearing this, Gorachand said to him with a smile,
"May Krishna soon show you mercy."

ইহা বলি' চরণ ধরিলা তার মাথে ।
প্রেমায় বিভোর হঞা নাচে ঊর্ধ্বহাথে ॥ ৬৭ ॥

ihā bali' caraṇa dharilā tāra māthe |
premāẏa bibhora hañā nāce ūrdhbahāthe || 67 ||

iha bali — saying this; charana dharila tara mathe — placed His feet upon his head; premaya vibhora hanya — intoxicated with prema; nache urdhva-hathe — dances with arms raised

67Saying this, He placed His feet upon his head
and, intoxicated with prema, dances with arms raised.

তারে অনুগ্রহ করি' সে দেশে রাখিয়া ।
অধিকার কৃষ্ণভক্তি তারে শিখাইয়া ॥ ৬৮ ॥

tāre anugraha kari' se deśe rākhiẏā |
adhikāra kṛṣṇabhakti tāre śikhāiẏā || 68 ||

tare anugraha kari — showing him mercy; se deshe rakhiya — leaving [him] in that land; adhikara krishna-bhakti — the right to devotion to Krishna; tare shikhaiya — teaching him

68Having shown him mercy, [the Lord] left him in that land,
taught him devotion to Krishna and gave him the right to it.10

হেনই সময়ে কহে বৈষ্ণব-সকল ।
অনেক অবস্থা কৈল তোমার নফর ॥ ৬৯ ॥

henai samaẏe kahe baiṣṇaba-sakala |
aneka abasthā kaila tomāra naphara || 69 ||

henai samaye — at that time; kahe vaishnava-sakala — all the Vaishnavas say; aneka avastha kaila — caused much trouble; tomara naphara — your servant

69At that time all the Vaishnavas say:
"Your servant caused us much trouble —

কাড়িয়া লইল আমা-সভার কম্বল ।
এ বোল শুনিঞা সেই সঙ্কোচ অন্তর ॥ ৭০ ॥

kāṛiẏā laila āmā-sabhāra kambala |
e bola śuniñā sei saṅkoca antara || 70 ||

kadiya laila — snatched away; ama-sabhara kambala — our blanket; e bola shuninya — hearing this; sei sankocha antara — he was embarrassed at heart

70he took away our blanket."
Hearing this, he was embarrassed at heart

নোতুন কম্বল দিল দানীর ঈশ্বর ।
সন্তুষ্ট হইল তবে বৈষ্ণব-অন্তর ॥ ৭১ ॥

notuna kambala dila dānīra īśbara |
santuṣṭa haila tabe baiṣṇaba-antara || 71 ||

notuna kambala dila — gave a new blanket; danira ishvara — the chief of the toll-collectors; santushta haila tabe — then were satisfied; vaishnava-antara — the Vaishnavas' hearts

71and gave them a new blanket, the chief of the toll-collectors;
then the Vaishnavas' hearts were at peace.

তবে সেই দানীশ্বর পরণাম করি' ।
বিদায় হইয়া গেলা আপনার বাড়ী ॥ ৭২ ॥

tabe sei dānīśbara paraṇāma kari' |
bidāẏa haiẏā gelā āpanāra bāṛī || 72 ||

tabe sei danishvara — then that chief of the toll-collectors; paranama kari — bowing down; vidaya haiya — taking leave; gela apanara badi — went to his home

72Then that chief of the toll-collectors, having bowed down,
took his leave and went home.

ঘরে গিয়া কৃষ্ণসেবা করিল আশ্রয় ।
সঙ্কীর্তনে হরিনামে অহর্নিশি রয় ॥ ৭৩ ॥

ghare giẏā kṛṣṇasebā karila āśraẏa |
saṅkīrtane harināme aharniśi raẏa || 73 ||

ghare giya — going home; krishna-seva karila ashraya — took refuge in Krishna's service; sankirtane hariname — in the sankirtana of Hari's name; aharnishi raya — remains day and night

73Returning home, he took refuge in the service of Krishna
and stays day and night in the sankirtana of Hari's name.

এইমতে সকল রজনী গেল সুখে ।
প্রাতঃকালে প্রাতঃক্রিয়া করিলা কৌতুকে ॥ ৭৪ ॥

eimate sakala rajanī gela sukhe |
prātaḥkāle prātaḥkriẏā karilā kautuke || 74 ||

eimate — thus; sakala rajani gela sukhe — the whole night passed happily; pratah-kale — in the morning; pratah-kriya karila kautuke — He joyfully did the morning rites

74Thus the whole night passed happily,
and in the morning [the Lord] joyfully performed the morning rites.

বিরজা দেখিতে প্রভু যায় আরবার ।
যাহা দেখি' সব লোক তরয়ে সংসার ॥ ৭৫ ॥

birajā dekhite prabhu yāẏa ārabāra |
yāhā dekhi' saba loka taraẏe saṃsāra || 75 ||

viraja dekhite — to see Viraja; prabhu yaya arabara — the Lord goes again; yaha dekhi — seeing whom; saba loka taraye samsara — all people cross worldly existence

75The Lord goes once more to see Viraja,
seeing whom all people cross the ocean of worldly existence.

বিরজাকে নমস্করি' চলি' যায় রঙ্গে ।
উঠিল কৃষ্ণের প্রেমা পুলকিত অঙ্গে ॥ ৭৬ ॥

birajāke namaskari' cali' yāẏa raṅge |
uṭhila kṛṣṇera premā pulakita aṅge || 76 ||

virajake namaskari — bowing to Viraja; chali yaya range — goes on joyfully; uthila krishnera prema — prema for Krishna arose; pulakita ange — His body thrilling

76Bowing to Viraja, He goes on joyfully;
prema for Krishna rose, His body thrilling.

চলিলা ঠাকুর সেই সিংহ-পরাক্রমে ।
ক্রমে ক্রমে উত্তরিলা একাম্র-গ্রামে ॥ ৭৭ ॥

calilā ṭhākura sei siṃha-parākrame |
krame krame uttarilā ekāmra-grāme || 77 ||

chalila thakura — the Thakura went; sei simha-parakrame — with a lion's might; krame krame — little by little; uttarila ekamra-grame — arrived at the village of Ekamra

77The Thakura went on with a lion's might
and little by little came to the village of Ekamra.

সেই গ্রামে আছে শিব পার্বতী-সহিতে ।
দেখিবারে ধায় প্রভু উনমত চিতে ॥ ৭৮ ॥

sei grāme āche śiba pārbatī-sahite |
dekhibāre dhāẏa prabhu unamata cite || 78 ||

sei grame achhe shiva — in that village is Shiva; parvati-sahite — with Parvati; dekhibare dhaya prabhu — the Lord hastens to see; unamata chite — beside Himself

78In that village is Shiva with Parvati;
the Lord, beside Himself, hastens to see them.

কথোদূর হৈতে প্রভু দেখিলা দেউল ।
উৎকণ্ঠা বাড়িল চিত্তে প্রেমায় বাউল ॥ ৭৯ ॥

kathodūra haite prabhu dekhilā deula |
utkaṇṭhā bāṛila citte premāẏa bāula || 79 ||

kathodura haite — from afar; prabhu dekhila deula — the Lord saw the temple; utkantha badila chitte — longing grew in His heart; premaya baula — mad with prema

79From afar the Lord saw the temple —
His longing grew, He was mad with prema.

দেউল-উপরে শোভে পতাকা সুন্দর ।
শিবলিঙ্গময় সেই একাম্র-নগর ॥ ৮০ ॥

deula-upare śobhe patākā sundara |
śibaliṅgamaẏa sei ekāmra-nagara || 80 ||

deula-upare — above the temple; shobhe pataka sundara — a beautiful flag shines; shiva-linga-maya — full of Shiva-lingas; sei ekamra-nagara — that town of Ekamra

80Above the temple a beautiful flag is flying;
the whole town of Ekamra is full of Shiva-lingas.

পতাকা দেখিয়া প্রভু নমস্কার করি' ।
ক্রমে ক্রমে গিয়া প্রবেশিলা শিবপুরী ॥ ৮১ ॥

patākā dekhiẏā prabhu namaskāra kari' |
krame krame giẏā prabeśilā śibapurī || 81 ||

pataka dekhiya — seeing the flag; prabhu namaskara kari — the Lord, bowing; krame krame giya — going little by little; praveshila shivapuri — entered the town of Shiva

81Seeing the flag, the Lord bowed down
and little by little entered the town of Shiva.

এককোটি লিঙ্গ আছে একাম্র-নগরে ।
হাঁটিয়া যাইতে প্রাণ হালে কাঁপে ডরে ॥ ৮২ ॥

ekakoṭi liṅga āche ekāmra-nagare |
hāṁṭiẏā yāite prāṇa hāle kāṁpe ḍare || 82 ||

eka-koti linga achhe — there are ten million lingas; ekamra-nagare — in the town of Ekamra; hantiya yaite — walking on foot; prana hale kampe dare — the heart shakes and trembles with fear

82Ten million lingas are in the town of Ekamra:
as one walks, the heart trembles with fear.11

বিশ্বেশ্বর আদি করি' আছে লিঙ্গ-কোটি ।
দেখিতে সন্দেশ যেন নগরের মাটি ॥ ৮৩ ॥

biśbeśbara ādi kari' āche liṅga-koṭi |
dekhite sandeśa yena nagarera māṭi || 83 ||

vishveshvara adi kari — Vishveshvara and the rest; achhe linga-koti — there are millions of lingas; dekhite sandesha yena — looks like sandesh; nagarera mati — the soil of the town

83Vishveshvara and the rest — millions of lingas;
the very soil of the town looks like sandesh.

মহাবিন্দু-সরোবরে সর্বতীর্থ-জলে ।
আর নানা পুণ্যতীর্থ বৈসয়ে নগরে ॥ ৮৪ ॥

mahābindu-sarobare sarbatīrtha-jale |
āra nānā puṇyatīrtha baisaẏe nagare || 84 ||

maha-bindu-sarovare — in the Maha-Bindu-sarovara; sarva-tirtha-jale — the water of all tirthas; ara nana punya-tirtha — and many other holy tirthas; baisaye nagare — are in the town

84In the Maha-Bindu-sarovara is the water of all holy places,
and many other holy tirthas are in the town.

পুরী প্রবেশিয়া দেখে পার্বতী-শঙ্কর ।
নমস্কার করি' প্রভু প্রেমায় বিভোর ॥ ৮৫ ॥

purī prabeśiẏā dekhe pārbatī-śaṅkara |
namaskāra kari' prabhu premāẏa bibhora || 85 ||

puri praveshiya — entering the town; dekhe parvati-shankara — He sees Parvati and Shankara; namaskara kari — bowing down; prabhu premaya vibhora — the Lord is rapt in prema

85Entering the town, [the Lord] sees Parvati and Shankara
and, bowing down, is rapt in prema.

সর্বজন দেখিল সে পার্বতী-মহেশ ।
লিঙ্গ-দরশনে সভার খণ্ডিলেক ক্লেশ ॥ ৮৬ ॥

sarbajana dekhila se pārbatī-maheśa |
liṅga-daraśane sabhāra khaṇḍileka kleśa || 86 ||

sarvajana dekhila — everyone saw; se parvati-mahesha — Parvati and Mahesha; linga-darashane — by the sight of the linga; sabhara khandileka klesha — everyone's afflictions were destroyed

86All beheld Parvati and Mahesha:
the sight of the linga ended everyone's afflictions.

মহেশ দেখিয়া প্রভুর অবশ শরীর ।
টলমল করে তনু নাহি রহে স্থির ॥ ৮৭ ॥

maheśa dekhiẏā prabhura abaśa śarīra |
ṭalamala kare tanu nāhi rahe sthira || 87 ||

mahesha dekhiya — seeing Mahesha; prabhura abasha sharira — the Lord's body out of control; talamala kare tanu — the body sways; nahi rahe sthira — does not stay steady

87Seeing Mahesha, the Lord lost control of His body:
His body sways, He cannot stand steady.

অরুণ-নয়নে জল ঝরে অনিবার ।
পুলকিত গণ্ড — স্তব পড়ে বার বার ॥ ৮৮ ॥

aruṇa-naẏane jala jhare anibāra |
pulakita gaṇḍa — staba paṛe bāra bāra || 88 ||

aruna-nayane — from reddish eyes; jala jhare anibara — tears flow without cease; pulakita ganda — cheeks thrilling; stava pade bara bara — He recites a hymn again and again

88From His reddish eyes tears flow without cease,
His cheeks thrill — again and again He recites a hymn.

Thus [the hymn]:

নমো নমস্তে ত্রিদশেশ্বরায় ভূতাধিনাথায় মৃড়ায় নিত্যং
গঙ্গাতরঙ্গোক্ষিত-বালচন্দ্র-চূড়ায় গৌরীনয়নোৎসবায় ।
সুতপ্তচামীকর-চন্দ্র-নীলপদ্ম-প্রবালাম্বুদ-কান্তিবক্ত্রৈঃ
সুনৃত্যরঙ্গেষ্টবরপ্রদায় কৈবল্যনাথায় বৃষধ্বজায় ॥ ৮৮+১ ॥

namo namaste tridaśeśbarāẏa bhūtādhināthāẏa mṛṛāẏa nityaṃ
gaṅgātaraṅgokṣita-bālacandra-cūṛāẏa gaurīnaẏanotsabāẏa |
sutaptacāmīkara-candra-nīlapadma-prabālāmbuda-kāntibaktraiḥ
sunṛtyaraṅgeṣṭabarapradāẏa kaibalyanāthāẏa bṛṣadhbajāẏa || 88+1 ||

namah namah te — obeisance, obeisance to you; tridasha-ishvaraya — to the lord of the gods; bhuta-adhinathaya — to the master of the bhutas; mridaya — to the Gracious One; nityam — forever; ganga-taranga-ukshita-bala-chandra-chudaya — whose crest is the young moon washed by the Ganga's waves; gauri-nayana-utsavaya — the festival of Gauri's eyes; sutapta-chamikara-chandra-nila-padma-pravala-ambuda-kanti-vaktraih — with faces shining like molten gold, the moon, the blue lotus, coral and the cloud; su-nritya-ranga-ishta-vara-pradaya — who grants desired boons in the arena of the beautiful dance; kaivalya-nathaya — to the lord of kaivalya; vrisha-dhvajaya — whose banner is the bull

88+1"Obeisance, obeisance to you forever — to the lord of the gods, the master of the bhutas, the Gracious One (Mrida), whose crest is the young moon washed by the waves of the Ganga, the festival of Gauri's eyes; to him whose faces shine like molten gold, the moon, the blue lotus, coral and the rain-cloud, who in the arena of the beautiful dance grants the desired boons — to the lord of kaivalya, whose banner is the bull!"12

এইমতে মহাপ্রভু পড়ে শিবস্তব ।
চৌদিগে স্তব পড়ে সকল বৈষ্ণব ॥ ৮৯ ॥

eimate mahāprabhu paṛe śibastaba |
caudige staba paṛe sakala baiṣṇaba || 89 ||

eimate — thus; mahaprabhu pade shiva-stava — Mahaprabhu recites a hymn to Shiva; chaudige — all around; stava pade sakala vaishnava — all the Vaishnavas recite hymns

89Thus Mahaprabhu recites a hymn to Shiva,
and all around Him all the Vaishnavas recite hymns.

হেনই সময়ে সেই শিবের সেবকে ।
গন্ধ, চন্দন, মালা দিলেন প্রভুকে ॥ ৯০ ॥

henai samaẏe sei śibera sebake |
gandha, candana, mālā dilena prabhuke || 90 ||

henai samaye — at that time; sei shivera sevake — Shiva's servants; gandha, chandana, mala — fragrance, sandal paste, a garland; dilena prabhuke — offered to the Lord

90At that time Shiva's servants
offered the Lord fragrance, sandal paste and a garland.

শিব নমস্করি' প্রভু বাহিরে আসিয়া ।
বিশ্রাম করিলা এক গৃহে প্রবেশিয়া ॥ ৯১ ॥

śiba namaskari' prabhu bāhire āsiẏā |
biśrāma karilā eka gṛhe prabeśiẏā || 91 ||

shiva namaskari — bowing to Shiva; prabhu bahire asiya — the Lord, coming outside; vishrama karila — rested; eka grihe praveshiya — entering a house

91Bowing to Shiva, the Lord came outside
and, entering a house, rested.

ভক্ত-নিবেদিত অন্ন ভোজন করিলা ।
পথের আয়াসে নিশি শুতিয়া রহিলা ॥ ৯২ ॥

bhakta-nibedita anna bhojana karilā |
pathera āẏāse niśi śutiẏā rahilā || 92 ||

bhakta-nivedita anna — food offered by a devotee; bhojana karila — He ate; pathera ayase — tired from the road; nishi shutiya rahila — lay down for the night

92He ate food offered by a devotee
and, tired from the road, lay down for the night.

শয়ন-সময়ে কৃষ্ণ-পাদাম্বুজ-ধ্যান ।
হেনকালে হৃদয়ে করয়ে অনুমান ॥ ৯২+১ ॥

śaẏana-samaẏe kṛṣṇa-pādāmbuja-dhyāna |
henakāle hṛdaẏe karaẏe anumāna || 92+1 ||

shayana-samaye — at the hour of sleep; krishna-padambuja-dhyana — meditation on Krishna's lotus feet; henakale — at that time; hridaye karaye anumana — He thinks in His heart

92+1At the hour of sleep, meditating on the lotus feet of Krishna,
He then thinks in His heart:

শিব-মহাপ্রসাদ পাইয়া ভাগ্যবশে ।
ভক্ষণ করিয়ে হেন আছি প্রতি-আশে ॥ ৯২+২ ॥

śiba-mahāprasāda pāiẏā bhāgyabaśe |
bhakṣaṇa kariẏe hena āchi prati-āśe || 92+2 ||

shiva-mahaprasada paiya — receiving Shiva's mahaprasada; bhagyavashe — by good fortune; bhakshana kariye — I would partake; hena achhi prati-ashe — such is My hope

92+2"If by good fortune I were to receive Shiva's mahaprasada,
I would partake of it — such is My hope."13

এইমতে মহাপ্রভুর অনুমান-কালে ।
পানা-পরসাদ লহ একজন বলে ॥ ৯২+৩ ॥

eimate mahāprabhura anumāna-kāle |
pānā-parasāda laha ekajana bale || 92+3 ||

eimate — thus; mahaprabhura anumana-kale — while Mahaprabhu was thinking; pana-parasada laha — "take the prasada, pana"; ekajana bale — someone says

92+3Just as Mahaprabhu thought this,
someone says, "Take this prasada — pana."

উঠিয়া প্রসাদ পানা লইলা ঠাকুর ।
পানা পান করি' সুখ বাড়িল প্রচুর ॥ ৯২+৪ ॥

uṭhiẏā prasāda pānā lailā ṭhākura |
pānā pāna kari' sukha bāṛila pracura || 92+4 ||

uthiya — rising; prasada pana laila thakura — the Thakura took the prasada, the pana; pana pana kari — drinking the pana; sukha badila prachura — His happiness grew greatly

92+4The Thakura rose and took the prasada, the pana;
drinking the pana, He was filled with happiness.

নিজজনে দিল যে আছিল অবশেষ ।
ভক্ষণ করিল সব ভক্ত সবিশেষ ॥ ৯২+৫ ॥

nijajane dila ye āchila abaśeṣa |
bhakṣaṇa karila saba bhakta sabiśeṣa || 92+5 ||

nijajane dila — He gave to His own people; ye achhila avashesha — what was left; bhakshana karila — partook; saba bhakta savishesha — all the devotees with special [reverence]

92+5What was left He gave to His own people,
and all the devotees partook of it with special reverence.

এইমতে আনন্দে বঞ্চিল সেই রাতি ।
প্রভাতে উঠিলা প্রভু ত্রিজগত-পতি ॥ ৯৩ ॥

eimate ānande bañcila sei rāti |
prabhāte uṭhilā prabhu trijagata-pati || 93 ||

eimate anande — thus in bliss; vanchila sei rati — He spent that night; prabhate uthila prabhu — at dawn the Lord rose; trijagata-pati — the Master of the three worlds

93Thus in bliss He spent that night;
at dawn the Lord rose, the Master of the three worlds.

প্রাতঃক্রিয়া করি' স্নান বিন্দু-সরোবরে ।
চলিলা ঠাকুর নমস্করি' মহেশ্বরে ॥ ৯৪ ॥

prātaḥkriẏā kari' snāna bindu-sarobare |
calilā ṭhākura namaskari' maheśbare || 94 ||

pratah-kriya kari — doing the morning rites; snana bindu-sarovare — bathing in the Bindu-sarovara; chalila thakura — the Thakura set out; namaskari maheshvare — bowing to Maheshvara

94Having done the morning rites and bathed in the Bindu-sarovara,
the Thakura set out, bowing to Maheshvara.

প্রভুর সংহতি সে চলিল নিজজন ।
এই প্রসঙ্গে এক কহিব কথন ॥ ৯৫ ॥

prabhura saṃhati se calila nijajana |
ei prasaṅge eka kahiba kathana || 95 ||

prabhura samhati — with the Lord; se chalila nijajana — His own people went; ei prasange — in this connection; eka kahiba kathana — I shall tell a story

95His own people went with the Lord.
In this connection I shall tell a story.

মুরারিতে দামোদরে যে হৈল বচন ।
শুন সাবধানে সভে কহিব এখন ॥ ৯৬ ॥

murārite dāmodare ye haila bacana |
śuna sābadhāne sabhe kahiba ekhana || 96 ||

murarite damodare — between Murari and Damodara; ye haila vachana — what was said; shuna savadhane sabhe — listen carefully, all; kahiba ekhana — I shall tell now

96What was said between Murari and Damodara —
listen, all of you, carefully: I shall tell it now.

মুরারিকে পুছিলা পণ্ডিত দামোদর ।
শিবের নির্মাল্য কেনে লইলা ঈশ্বর ॥ ৯৭ ॥

murārike puchilā paṇḍita dāmodara |
śibera nirmālya kene lailā īśbara || 97 ||

murarike puchhila — asked Murari; pandita damodara — Pandita Damodara; shivera nirmalya — the remnants of offerings to Shiva; kene laila ishvara — why did the Lord accept

97Pandita Damodara asked Murari:
"Why did the Lord accept the remnants of offerings to Shiva?

অগ্রাহ্য শিবের নির্মাল্য ভৃগু-শাপে ।
তবে কেনে পরিগ্রহ কৈল প্রভু আপে ॥ ৯৮ ॥

agrāhya śibera nirmālya bhṛgu-śāpe |
tabe kene parigraha kaila prabhu āpe || 98 ||

agrahya shivera nirmalya — the remnants of offerings to Shiva are not to be accepted; bhrigu-shape — because of Bhrigu's curse; tabe kene parigraha kaila — why then did accept; prabhu ape — the Lord Himself

98Because of Bhrigu's curse, the remnants of offerings to Shiva are not to be accepted —
why then did the Lord Himself accept them?

আপনে ব্রহ্মণ্যদেব এই মহাপ্রভু ।
জানিঞা শুনিঞা কেনে লঙ্ঘিবেক তভু ॥ ৯৯ ॥

āpane brahmaṇyadeba ei mahāprabhu |
jāniñā śuniñā kene laṅghibeka tabhu || 99 ||

apane brahmanya-deva — Himself Brahmanya-deva; ei mahaprabhu — is this Mahaprabhu; janinya shuninya — knowingly; kene langhibeka tabhu — why then would He transgress

99This Mahaprabhu is Himself Brahmanya-deva:
how could He knowingly transgress [the rule]?"14

মুরারি কহয়ে — শুন শুন দামোদর ।
আমি কি জানিয়ে প্রভুর মরম-উত্তর ॥ ১০০ ॥

murāri kahaẏe — śuna śuna dāmodara |
āmi ki jāniẏe prabhura marama-uttara || 100 ||

murari kahaye — Murari says; shuna shuna damodara — listen, listen, Damodara; ami ki janiye — what do I know; prabhura marama-uttara — of the Lord's inner answer

100Murari replies, "Listen, listen, Damodara:
what do I know of the Lord's inner answer?

নিজ-বুদ্ধি-অনুমানে যে কহি উত্তর ।
তোর মনে লয় যদি রাখিহ অন্তর ॥ ১০১ ॥

nija-buddhi-anumāne ye kahi uttara |
tora mane laẏa yadi rākhiha antara || 101 ||

nija-buddhi-anumane — by the inference of my own mind; ye kahi uttara — the answer I give; tora mane laya yadi — if your mind accepts it; rakhiha antara — keep it in your heart

101I shall answer what I infer by my own understanding —
if your mind accepts it, keep it in your heart.

শিবের সেবক যেই শিব-সেবা করে ।
উচ্ছিষ্ট না লয় — হরি-হরে ভেদ করে ॥ ১০২ ॥

śibera sebaka yei śiba-sebā kare |
ucchiṣṭa nā laẏa — hari-hare bheda kare || 102 ||

shivera sevaka yei — the servant of Shiva who; shiva-seva kare — serves Shiva; uchchhishta na laya — does not accept remnants; hari-hare bheda kare — makes a difference between Hari and Hara

102A servant of Shiva who serves Shiva
but does not accept [Hari's] remnants, making a difference between Hari and Hara —

তাহারে ব্রাহ্মণ-শাপ — কহিল এ তত্ত্ব ।
অশুদ্ধ তাহার মতি না জানে মহত্ত্ব ॥ ১০৩ ॥

tāhāre brāhmaṇa-śāpa — kahila e tattba |
aśuddha tāhāra mati nā jāne mahattba || 103 ||

tahare brahmana-shapa — on him is the brahmana's curse; kahila e tattva — this is the truth; ashuddha tahara mati — his mind is impure; na jane mahattva — he does not know the greatness

103to him the brahmana's curse applies; this is the point:
his mind is impure, he does not know [Shiva's] greatness.

অভিন্ন করিয়া যেই করয়ে সেবন ।
শিবের নির্মাল্য সেই করয়ে ভক্ষণ ॥ ১০৪ ॥

abhinna kariẏā yei karaẏe sebana |
śibera nirmālya sei karaẏe bhakṣaṇa || 104 ||

abhinna kariya — without dividing; yei karaye sevana — whoever serves; shivera nirmalya — the remnants of offerings to Shiva; sei karaye bhakshana — he partakes of

104But one who serves without dividing them
partakes of the remnants of offerings to Shiva.

শিবের নির্মাল্য খায় অভেদ-চরিত ।
সে জনে অধিক হরি-হরের পীরিত ॥ ১০৫ ॥

śibera nirmālya khāẏa abheda-carita |
se jane adhika hari-harera pīrita || 105 ||

shivera nirmalya khaya — eats the remnants of offerings to Shiva; abheda-charita — [one whose] conduct makes no division; se jane adhika — in that person more; hari-harera pirita — love for Hari and Hara

105The remnants of offerings to Shiva are eaten by one whose conduct makes no division:
in such a one there is greater love for both Hari and Hara.

মহেশ্বর প্রভু সব বৈষ্ণবের রাজা ।
সেই-ভাবে যেই জন করে তাঁর পূজা ॥ ১০৬ ॥

maheśbara prabhu saba baiṣṇabera rājā |
sei-bhābe yei jana kare tāṁra pūjā || 106 ||

maheshvara prabhu — lord Maheshvara; saba vaishnavera raja — king of all Vaishnavas; sei-bhave — in that mood; yei jana kare tanra puja — whoever worships him

106Maheshvara is the king of all Vaishnavas;
whoever worships him seeing him thus —

তাহার হস্তেতে শিব করেন ভোজন ।
সে প্রসাদ খাইলে হয় বন্ধ-বিমোচন ॥ ১০৭ ॥

tāhāra hastete śiba karena bhojana |
se prasāda khāile haẏa bandha-bimocana || 107 ||

tahara hastete — from his hand; shiva karena bhojana — Shiva eats; se prasada khaile — eating that prasada; haya bandha-vimochana — there is release from bondage

107from that person's hand Shiva partakes [of the offering];
eat such prasada, and bondage falls away.

বস্তুত সে মহেশ্বর প্রভুর গমনে ।
আতিথ্য করিল সে পরম-হর্ষ-মনে ॥ ১০৮ ॥

bastuta se maheśbara prabhura gamane |
ātithya karila se parama-harṣa-mane || 108 ||

vastuta — in truth; se maheshvara — that Maheshvara; prabhura gamane — at the Lord's passing; atithya karila — offered hospitality; parama-harsha-mane — with great joy in his heart

108In truth, that Maheshvara, as the Lord passed by,
offered Him hospitality with great joy in his heart.

শাপ আদি যত শুন বহির্মুখ প্রতি ।
সুহৃদ্ভাবে কৈলে হয় শ্রীকৃষ্ণে পীরিতি ॥ ১০৯ ॥

śāpa ādi yata śuna bahirmukha prati |
suhṛdbhābe kaile haẏa śrīkṛṣṇe pīriti || 109 ||

shapa adi yata — curses and the like; shuna — listen; bahirmukha prati — are for those turned away; suhrid-bhave kaile — when done in the mood of a friend; haya shri-krishne piriti — love for Sri Krishna arises

109Curses and the like, listen, are for those turned away [from the Lord];
but when [Shiva] is worshipped as [Hari's] friend, love for Sri Krishna arises.15

লোকশিক্ষা-হেতু প্রভু কৈল অবতার ।
দামোদর বোলে — এবে ঘুচিল জঞ্জাল ॥ ১১০ ॥

lokaśikṣā-hetu prabhu kaila abatāra |
dāmodara bole — ebe ghucila jañjāla || 110 ||

loka-shiksha-hetu — for the teaching of the people; prabhu kaila avatara — the Lord descended; damodara bole — Damodara says; ebe ghuchila janjala — now the tangle is removed

110The Lord descended to teach the people."
Damodara says, "Now the knot is untied!"

শুনিঞা সকল লোক আনন্দিত-চিত ।
কহয়ে লোচনদাস চৈতন্যচরিত ॥ ১১১ ॥

śuniñā sakala loka ānandita-cita |
kahaẏe locanadāsa caitanyacarita || 111 ||

shuninya sakala loka — hearing, all the people; anandita-chita — rejoice at heart; kahaye lochanadasa — Lochana Dasa tells; chaitanya-charita — the deeds of Chaitanya

111Hearing this, all the people rejoice at heart.
Lochana Dasa tells of the deeds of Chaitanya.

✦

Notes

  1. The OCR of the summary is garbled in places; gaps are filled by sense and from the table of contents in the edition's preface (ch. 16). "Concern for the keeping of sannyasa" is a conjectural reading (OCR «অন্গটাস-সংরগণ-চিস্ত।»). The summary covers the whole section, whose end is in en/45. In the 1983 edition this section continues chapter 16 ("Sri Nilachala-yatra"), with new numbering.
  2. Vv. 1–31 — cf. Murari 3.6. Tamoluk (Tamolipta, Tamralipta) is present-day Tamluk in Bengal.
  3. So too in Murari (3.6.4): the Gopala of Remuna was once installed in Varanasi by Uddhava and came here to show mercy to a brahmana. In the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 4) the Deity of Remuna is Gopinatha Kshirachora, while the story of Gopala who followed a brahmana is told of Sakshi-gopala (Madhya 5).
  4. Cf. Murari 3.6.8–9: the crown fell from the Deity's head, and the Lord caught it.
  5. So says the mahatmya (glorification) of the holy place; likewise in Murari (3.6.16). For a Vaishnava the highest fruit of pilgrimage is not such rewards but prema — which is what the Lord asks of Viraja (v. 31).
  6. The Lord, playing the part of a devotee, asks of the goddess only love for Krishna (cf. Murari 3.6.18) — as the gopis prayed to Katyayani for Krishna.
  7. Trilochana ("the Three-eyed") is a linga of Shiva; the town is compared to Varanasi (cf. Murari 3.6.20). According to Murari this is Yajapura; Ekamra (Bhubaneshvara) comes below, v. 77.
  8. A verse from the Shanti-shataka. In A it is followed by Bhaktisiddhanta's anvaya and Bengali translation (OCR garbled); the text of the verse is restored from B. Vv. 36–73 — cf. Murari 3.7.
  9. V. 53+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition does not have it.
  10. The dream vision is Lochana Dasa's; in Murari (3.7.12) the chief of the toll-collectors simply comes to the Lord.
  11. For fear of stepping on a linga.
  12. V. 88+1 (the hymn to Shiva) is found only in the 1983 edition and in the 1903 edition; Bhaktisiddhanta's edition does not have it. These are verses 3.8.13–14 of Murari Gupta's poem. The Lord, playing the part of a devotee, honours Shiva as the greatest of Vaishnavas and prays to him for love of Hari (Murari 3.8).
  13. Vv. 92+1 — 92+5 are found only in the 1983 edition and (with variants) in the 1903 edition. Cf. Murari 3.9: the Lord desires Shiva's prasada and, receiving it, partakes of it with reverence. Pana is a sweet cooling drink.
  14. Brahmanya-deva — "the God who favours brahmanas": He does not break a brahmana's word. Bhrigu's curse on the worshippers of Shiva — Bhagavata Purana 4.2. The conversation follows Murari 3.9 (Murari telling the story to Damodara Pandita).
  15. "Without division" (abheda) here is not a mayavada identification: Shiva is not worshipped as a separate god independent of Krishna and His rival, but honoured as the best of Vaishnavas (Bhagavata Purana 12.13.16), inseparable from the Lord (cf. Brahma-samhita 5.45: Shambhu is to the Lord as curd is to milk). Bhaktisiddhanta in his summary states the conclusion thus: the remnants of offerings to Shiva worshipped by non-devotees are not to be accepted (cf. vv. 102–103, 109).
